name: 🚀 CI/CD Pipeline: Build, Push Docker Image & Deploy to Render

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-push-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # 1. Checkout your repository
      - name: 📥 Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2. Set up Docker Buildx for multi-arch builds
      - name: 🔧 Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      # 3. Log in to Docker Hub using your secrets
      - name: 🔐 Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      # 4. Build and push multi-architecture Docker image
      - name: 🏗️ Build & Push Docker Image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          tags: |
            ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/my-awesome-website:latest
            ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/my-awesome-website:${{ github.sha }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      # 5. Install the Render CLI
      - name: 📥 Install Render CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/render-oss/cli/refs/heads/main/bin/install.sh | sh

      # 6. Authenticate Render CLI using your Render API key
      - name: 🔐 Authenticate Render CLI
        env:
          RENDER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION }}
        run: |
          render login --token $RENDER_TOKEN

      # 7. Trigger a Render deploy, waiting until completion
      - name: 🚀 Trigger Render Production Deploy
        run: |
          render deploy \
            --service production \
            --image ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}/my-awesome-website:latest \
            --wait
